videoModels.name: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B
videoModels.licenseGate: verify exact checkpoint card and model files before use
videoModels.hardwareNotes: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B: upstream documents 720p at 24fps and at least 24GB VRAM for single-GPU inference with offload; 80GB-class GPUs can run without the memory-saving offload flags. Wan 2.2 T2V-A14B/I2V-A14B are separate heavier candidates and require a separate benchmark.

videoModels.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
videoModels.hardwareNotes: Upstream documents minimum 14GB NVIDIA GPU memory with model offloading enabled; Linux, Python 3.10+ and compatible CUDA/PyTorch. Actual speed/quality varies by 480p/720p checkpoint and distillation variant.

videoModels.name: LTX-2.5
videoModels.license: LTX-2.x Community License for weights; code license is separate
videoModels.licenseGate: LTX-2.x Community License: commercial use without paid license is limited to entities with annual revenue below USD 10 million; at or above USD 10 million a paid commercial agreement is required. Verify current license, revenue threshold and restrictions.
videoModels.hardwareNotes: LTX-2.5 official minimum: NVIDIA GPU with 32GB+ VRAM, 32GB system RAM, 100GB free storage, CUDA 12.7+ and Python 3.12+. Recommended: A100 80GB or H100, 64GB+ RAM and 200GB SSD.
videoModels.notes: Repository code is Apache-2.0; model weights are separately licensed. Check the exact checkpoint and any bundled text encoder/third-party model licenses.

renderers.name: HyperFrames
renderers.notes: Deterministic HTML/CSS/seekable animation to video. Validate current CLI, FFmpeg requirements and exact render flags before wiring automation.

renderers.name: Remotion
renderers.notes: Source-available under proprietary terms. Individual/small-company free license covers up to 3 people; companies of 4+ require Company License. Remotion for Automators is priced at $0.01 per render with a $100/month minimum, so it is not suitable for the no-added-cost automated production default.
